meta.name: campaign-analytics
meta.description: Analyzes campaign performance with multi-touch attribution, funnel conversion analysis, and ROI calculation for marketing optimization. Use when analyzing marketing campaigns, ad performance, attribution models, conversion rates, or calculating marketing ROI, ROAS, CPA, and campaign metrics across channels.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析营销活动效果，计算归因与ROI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要评估多渠道营销活动的投入产出比。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze campaign performance with attribution and ROI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to evaluate ROI across multiple marketing channels.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以分析营销活动数据，包括多渠道归因、漏斗转化和 ROI 计算，并输出文本或 JSON 格式报告。
howto.when: 当你需要分析营销活动效果、广告表现、归因模型、转化率或计算 ROI、ROAS、CPA 等指标时触发。

say.text: 分析这份营销活动的归因模型，使用时间衰减模型。
say.note: Claude 会运行归因分析脚本并输出结果。

say.text: 计算这个漏斗各阶段的转化率和流失点。
say.note: Claude 会运行漏斗分析脚本并识别瓶颈。

say.text: 评估这次广告活动的 ROI 和 ROAS。
say.note: Claude 会运行 ROI 计算脚本并给出指标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze campaign performance including multi-touch attribution, funnel conversion, and ROI calculation, outputting text or JSON reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze marketing campaign performance, ad performance, attribution models, conversion rates, or calculate ROI, ROAS, CPA, and other metrics.

say_en.text: Analyze the attribution model for this campaign using time-decay.
say_en.note: Claude runs the attribution analysis script and outputs results.

say_en.text: Calculate conversion rates and drop-off points for this funnel.
say_en.note: Claude runs the funnel analysis script and identifies bottlenecks.

say_en.text: Evaluate ROI and ROAS for this ad campaign.
say_en.note: Claude runs the ROI calculation script and provides metrics.
